caption:
Figure 2: OpenAgentFlow normalizes instrumented actions into AgentEvents and checks them
with a shared PEP before execution; the control plane maintains policy, provenance, session, audit,
and update state.
delegated_acceptance_review: Viewed draft and final and read caption plus eight independent checks. Full original graph is restored, including every control/action-plane field, T1–T4, update chain, response handler and audit path. New outcome key repeats exact meanings from original response-handler text. Source DENY/ESCALATE outward-arrow ambiguity is preserved and not claimed to be resolved by the footer; it remains a potential graphical-consistency limitation for blind scoring. No scientific rewriting.
